logHint: A finished meditation is written with #meditation(duration) and the care tag, so it shows in your timeline and in the tracker.
noList: No meditations in this list yet.
noVideo: The video does not play here. You can watch it on YouTube and mark it finished below.
logPrompt: Log this meditation to your timeline?
noteHint: The tracker is written as #meditation(duration), and the teacher with @name.
deleteBody: It is removed from your list. Your timeline is not changed.
clearBody: The history of meditations is removed. Your timeline is not changed.
durationFormat: The duration is hh:mm or hh:mm:ss, for example 00:10:00.
ytIdHint: The YouTube id is the 11 characters after v= in the link.
noteLine: The note needs a line, for example #meditation(00:10:00).
